advancements.orespawn_delight.chef_de_ch: Chef de Chaos
OreSpawn's beasts, bugs and bosses — now on the menu.
Jurassic Pork
Butcher a dinosaur for your first cut of raw dino meat.
Squid Pro Quo
Relieve a Kraken of one of its tentacles.
On the Cutting Edge
Slice a Kraken Tentacle into Calamari Rings on a cutting board.
That's How I Roll
Craft the whole sushi lineup: Crab Roll, Flounder Roll and Irukandji Roll.
Sting Operation
Eat an Irukandji Roll and gamble on the venom.
Soup There It Is
Cook all six cooking pot meals: Dino Stew, Whale Chowder, Shark Fin Soup, Ink-Black Pasta, Jellyfish Salad and a Quinoa Bowl.
The Upper Crust
Stack all five sandwiches and burgers, from Grilled Cheese to the Mobzilla Burger.
Cart Blanche
Grab dinner on the go: a Dino Dog, a Kraken Dog and a Sea Viper Skewer.
Glow Getter
Eat Irradiated Jerky. It's fine. You're fine. You're also glowing.
Sow It Begins
Plant one of OreSpawn's long-dormant seeds, or bring in a harvest of its crops.
Knife to Meet You
Forge the Tiger's Eye Knife, the sharpest thing in any kitchen.
Feast Mode
Set the table with all three centerpieces: Rex Roast, Mobzilla Feast and the Queen's Banquet.
Five-Star Chaos
Eat every single dish on the OreSpawn Delight menu. Yes, all twenty-seven.
